text:
nina: Heads-up: press inbound today referencing the Optimize benchmark. Small ask 1) confirm the canonical stat we want quoted externally, 2) any embargoed follow-ups we should hold.

leo: Canonical stat = "up to 3x token throughput on real-world LLM tasks". Use that exact phrasing. No embargoed extras beyond the blog assets.

james: Who's the media contact if someone asks for deeper infra details? Research or eng-ml?

maria: Assign technical follow-ups to eng-ml (cate) and customer/enterprise questions to PR (nina).

cate: I'll be on standby for technical deep-dives. If they ask for raw rigs or internal perf logs, we should offer a sanitized summary only.

press-bot: Press alert: mention detected - outlet=the_hub status=live timestamp=1804012250 link=https://thehub.com/article/optimize-coverage

nina: Quick check - do we want to proactively reach out to outlets that used outdated language (e.g., "10x")? Or wait for them to correct?

leo: Proactive outreach for top-tier outlets; for smaller blogs wait. Send correction language + methodology link.

maria: I'll draft the correction note. Keep it short and factual, offer a quote call if they need context.

james: Also: please make sure all social cards use the canonical stat. I've seen drafts with variations.

cate: Confirmed assets updated: s3://redwood-assets/optimize/social_cards_v2.zip (contains updated hero stat).

press-bot: Asset update logged by cate at 1804012280

nina: Draft correction note (paste):
"Hi [Name], thanks for the coverage. Quick correction: our benchmark shows up to 3x token throughput improvement in the tested workloads; full methodology: https://redwood.com/assets/optimize/methodology-v1.2.pdf. Happy to provide a short on-the-record comment.
Thanks,
Nina"

leo: Good. Add CEO availability line for top-tier.

maria: Sent to NYT contact and The Hub; tracker updated.

press-bot: Outreach logged: reporter=nyt_reporter@nyt.com status=contacted method=email timestamp=1804012330

james: NYT replied: "We'll update in our next edit." I'll mark as resolved.

nina: Wrapping up: PR monitoring checklist done. If anyone sees persistent misquotes, escalate to me directly. Thanks all. :raised_hands:
